observation.visible_scene: A white ceramic cup with its handle on the left rests in a bed of roasted coffee beans spread over a folded tan burlap cloth, set against a uniform black background. A plume of pale, semi-transparent steam rises from the cup's rim.
visible_changes: The steam column continuously rises and morphs: its width, swirl pattern, and brightness change from frame to frame, with wisps curling, thinning, and reforming as they ascend and dissipate into the dark background.
The cup, the surrounding coffee beans, and the burlap folds remain fixed in position and appearance throughout the excerpt; no object translation or deformation occurs.
The framing of the cup and beans stays constant across all frames, indicating no detectable camera movement within this segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: What heated the liquid and produced the steam, and any change in the cup's contents or the steam's intensity after the excerpt ends.
Whether the steam was already present before the first sampled frame or began at some unseen earlier moment.
uncertain_details: The exact source region of the vapor within the cup is not visible (the interior is hidden by the rim), so the steam is only observed emerging above the opening.
The apparent steadiness of the camera is inferred from the static background and objects; subtle motion cannot be fully ruled out.
